description: A compact derivative of Open Scriptures' Strong's Dictionary JSON, keyed by Strong's number. Retains lemma, transliteration, pronunciation (Hebrew only), derivation, the Strong's-def gloss, and the KJV-def usage note for every entry.
license: CC-BY-SA (Open Scriptures); underlying 1890s Strong's Concordance text is public domain
attribution: Open Scriptures' Strong's Dictionaries of Hebrew and Greek, https://github.com/openscriptures/strongs
changes: Extracted the greek/strongs-greek-dictionary.js CommonJS module's data object.
Renamed fields to a stable schema (lemma/translit/pron/derivation/meaning/usage) shared across both languages.
No placeholder-token normalization was needed for the Greek usage notes.
Compressed the whole per-language dictionary into one gzip artifact (lookup is by Strong's number, not by book/verse, so no per-book split is needed).
